# Virtual Location Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:VirtualLocationType`](gmeow-VirtualLocationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/VirtualLocationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The kind of a virtual location (video conference, chat space, metaverse room, website, social media page, …). A value, not a subclass: the set is open-ended and they share all of [`VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md)'s structure, so a new kind is a new individual, not a new class ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:VirtualLocationType`](gmeow-VirtualLocationType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
